data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words 'mit' (Moon) and 'lesh' (Goddess), the name Mithlesh signifies the 'Moon Goddess'. In Hindu mythology, the Moon is considered the god of emotions and the giver of happiness. This name is believed to bring peace, tranquility, and emotional balance. The name Mithlesh carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mithlesh usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Mithilesh is a popular Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit name 'Mithila', which was the ancient name for the region in the eastern part of the Indian subcontinent, now known as Nepal and the Indian states of Bihar and West Bengal. Mithila is also the name of the legendary queen of Videha, who was famously called 'Mithilesh' in reverence.

Another reference to the name 'Mithilesh' can be found in the Hindu epic 'Ramayana', where Mithilesh is the name of King Janaka's queen, who gave birth to Lord Rama. This queen was also known as 'Sita', and was famously abducted by the demon king Ravana.
